78
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 20, 2004/Agrahayana 29, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries  and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development;
Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Undesirable channels on DTH
Television
*261. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND BROAD-
CASTING  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that it has become
possible for the DTH  Television users to
view certain undesirable channels using
certain types of Smart Cards;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how  this misuse of the system is
proposed to be curtailed?
Oppression of downtrodden
†*262.SHRI  P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the incidents of oppressions of
downtrodden taking  place in the present
time;
(b) if so, whether Government are
formulating any action plan to check such
incidents;
(c) whether Government propose to
constitute any monitoring agency in this
regard;
(d) if so,  details thereof; and
(e) if not, the effective measures being
taken by Government?
Reservation to SCs/STs and Physically
Handicapped
*263. SHRI GANDHI AZAD: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the ‘‘All India Association
for SCs/STs  and Physically Handicapped
Peoples Upliftment" has recently brought
to the notice of PMO the facts  about
reservation to SCs/STs  and Physically
Handicapped as per provision made in
1974 for  N.G.Os;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken thereon; and

79
(c) if no action has been taken so far,
the reasons therefor and  by when, the
action will be taken on 1974 provision?
Special  package to boost exports
*264. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose
special packages  for boosting exports in
the textiles, tea and coffee industries as a
follow-up    to the Foreign Trade Policy;
(b) if so, whether Government have felt
a need for special emphasis on some sectors
in which the country had natural abilities;
(c) if so, the details of the packages
prepared in regard to tea and coffee; and
(d)  by when these are likely to be
announced and implemented?
Economic Cooperation with Pakistan
*265. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to implement the ‘‘Early Harvest Scheme
(EHS)’’ for economic cooperation  with
Pakistan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether representatives of both the
countries have recently met to discuss the
possibilities of economic  cooperation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Recognition to small and regional
political parties
†*266. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a discussion has been held
recently to reconsider recognition of the
small and regional political parties and to
take an initiative to control  regionalism;
(b) if so, whether the Election
Commission  has suggested that it is
necessary to think over the recognition of
the political parties; and
(c) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Delivery of degrees to students of Delhi
University
*267. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
several lakh students, who have passed out
from Delhi University during the last ten
years, have not been able to get their
degrees from the Delhi University because
of cumbersome rules adopted by the
University;
(b) if so, the number of degrees still
lying in the University;
(c) whether any efforts were made to
send those degrees to the students by post
and if so, with what result; and
(d) the steps being taken for the early
delivery of degree to the students?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

80
Explosives in imported
metal scrap
@*268. SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) the countries from where metal scrap
was allowed to be imported during 2004;
(b) whether the imported metal scrap
contained explosive  war-heads both used
and live that caused loss of life and property
as live war-heads exploded  at various
places in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken/proposed  to be
taken to ensure that such dangerous imports
are banned?
Agreement with Gulf Cooperation
Council

Will the Minister of COMMERC

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the December 20, 2004/Agrahayana 29, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Development of North-Eastern
Region; Heavy Industries  and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development;
Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development; Urban
Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Indo-Sri Lankan agreement
1745. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and Sri
Lanka propose to workout a
comprehensive economic partnership
agreement;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) the details of the current
impediments coming in the way of free
flow of trade which are proposed to be
addressed?
Effect of Iraq war on perfume
industry
†1746.  SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to war in
Iraq, the Indian perfume industry especially
the industries hailing from Kanauj have
suffered colossal loss;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures being taken to protect
the Indian perfume industry?
Office of Explosive Department in
Gujarat
1747. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a proposal from the State Government of
Gujarat for opening of a separate office of
the Explosive Department at Alang Ship
Recycling Yard in Gujarat; and
(b) if so, the decision taken in this
regard?
Setting up of units abroad
1748. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI  AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Indian Firms have found it cheaper to
setup production bases in the nations with
which India has signed FTA; and
(b) if so, the beneficiary from FTA?

386
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Third country imports
1749. SHRIMATI   AMBIKA  SONI:
SHRI  SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the goods
from a third country are being pushed into
India after being shown as coming from
Thailand or Sri Lanka;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner Government plan
to stop this practice?
Misuse of export incentive schemes
1750. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that a large number
of exporters have cheated Government
through bogus exports by misusing various
export incentive schemes;
(b) if so, the number of cases in which
action has been taken and the names of
those under probe at present; and
(c) the amount involved in those cases?
India's share in international exports/
imports
†1751. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's
exports share is only 0.8 per cent in the
international trade market of the world
whereas share of U.S.A. and Germany is
about 11 per cent and 10 per cent;
respectively;
(b) if not, the facts in this respect and
whether any estimate has also been made
about the imports of the country in the
international market; and
(c) if so, the percentage thereof and how
much decrease or increase has been
registered from 1999 till 2004?
Utilization of export potential
†1752. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH  MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
Mckinsey and Company's report stating
that by improving taxation the export
potential of the country worth 300 billion
dollar can be utilized;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether those taxes have been
identified by Government where
improvement is needed; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Modernisation of leather industry
1753. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of West
Bengal has requested for release of Rs. 400
crores funds for leather industry
modernisation; and
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto?

387
Fake tickets at ITPO
1754. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI DARA SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
tickets of the India International Trade Fair,
2004 (IITF) were printed in more numbers
than were ordered by the India Trade
Promotion Organisation (ITPO);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether fake tickets was the reason
for unprecedented rush at the IITF;
(d) whether an enquiry has been ordered
to look into the matter;
